claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Nokia 一手（季報 6-K、20-F、法說）寫出 San Jose 6 吋廠延後或取消、Arizona 收購未完成；或寫出 San Jose 已量產（後者是加強——6 吋 InP 層讀圖的反證①會醒）。核查頻率：每季（Nokia 季報 6-K）。觸發後 48 小時：重讀 6 吋 InP 產線層的供給側列舉與時鐘。
claims.statement: Nokia (supplier self-statement) at OCP Global Summit 2026: 'Nokia: 6-inch InP platform' — 3-inch Sunnyvale (1st InP fab), new 6-inch San Jose (2nd InP fab) and new 6-inch Arizona (3rd InP fab); 'Nokia is investing in 6-inch manufacturing to significantly scale capacity.' Nokia's Q2 2026 6-K (same origin, not a second source) says the new San Jose fab is on track to begin ramping production later in Q4 2026 and the Arizona site (NXP Chandler) will be converted to InP production after leasing capacity from early 2027. Development, not volume production. The slide's 'Customers are asking for ~10x InP volume by the end of the decade' is the supplier relaying customers' forecast (context only).
